intent: Make the bash tool's system-prompt snippet explicit that timeout is measured in seconds, preventing models from passing millisecond values like 120000 for a two-minute cap.
find: promptSnippet: "Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.)",
replace: promptSnippet: "Execute bash commands (ls, grep, find, etc.); timeout is in seconds (e.g. timeout=120 for 2 minutes, never milliseconds)",

references.reason: Observed gpt-5.5 repeatedly passing bash timeout=120000 after reading test code with timeoutMs values; Pi correctly interprets bash timeout as seconds, so the model-facing snippet needs the unit.

intent: Make /reload reopen the current session file from disk before rebuilding chat, so the same session is refreshed instead of keeping stale in-memory entries.

references.reason: Observed /reload should reopen/refresh the session it was invoked from; upstream reload only rebuilt resources and reused stale in-memory session entries before interactive rebuilt chat. Guarded with existsSync so a brand-new unflushed session keeps its in-memory model/thinking metadata, and reload uses the file's latest leaf so newly appended entries become visible.

intent: Immediately before persisting a toolResult message, ensure the active session leaf is on the parent chain below the assistant message containing the matching toolCallId. This makes final tool-result parenting robust even if message_end extension hooks branch the session leaf after another repair hook runs.
find:
// Regular LLM message - persist as SessionMessageEntry
                this.sessionManager.appendMessage(event.message);
verify: // Tool results must persist below the assistant message that emitted their tool call,

references.reason: pi-lane can expose the core bug by moving the session leaf during message_end hooks, but the toolResult/toolCall persistence invariant is generic Pi behavior.
pi-background-bash has defensive detached tool-result repairs/provenance because delayed bash completions can encounter the same generic core ordering/persistence class.

intent: Wrap bare URLs in rendered bash tool output with OSC 8 so long URLs remain one clickable/copyable link across terminal line wraps.

references.reason: Observed a Turborepo warning URL in bash tool output wrapping as plain text; terminal copy only captured the first visual line (ending team-members-and-r).

intent: Apply bash output URL linkification before coloring each rendered output line.

intent: Add a lightweight LaTeX math preprocessor for Markdown chat output. It protects code spans/fences, detects $...$, $$...$$, \(...\), and \[...\], strips simple text macros, and runs unicodeit to render terminal-friendly Unicode math.
replace:
import { Marked, Tokenizer } from "marked";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";

references.reason: Pi terminal markdown showed raw LaTeX math (e.g. Beta-Binomial equations) in chat; use unicodeit as a lightweight robust text renderer before considering image-based MathJax/KaTeX.

intent: Run Markdown input through the LaTeX-to-Unicode preprocessor before marked lexing, so math delimiters render as readable terminal Unicode instead of raw TeX.
